title: Cresyl diphenyl phosphate (a novel organophosphate ester) induces hepatic steatosis by directly binding to liver X receptor alpha: From molecule action to risk assessment.
authors: Liu, Xinya; Sun, Lanchao; Lin, Yongfeng; Du, Jingyue; Yang, Huizi; Li, Chuanhai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究有机磷酸酯CDP与核受体LXRα的结合及致肝脂肪变性机制，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但对象为核受体-配体而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cresyl diphenyl phosphate (CDP), a novel organophosphate ester (OPE), has been increasingly detected in various environmental and human samples. However, its toxicity, mechanisms, and health risks remain largely unknown. In this work, we investigated CDP-induced hepatic steatosis through Liver X Receptor alpha (LXRalpha) pathway across the molecular interactions, signaling pathways, cell functions, animal effects, and population risks, and compared them to triphenyl phosphate (TPHP) and tricresyl phosphate (TCRP). Receptor binding results showed that all three OPEs bound to LXRalpha directly in the order of TCRP > CDP > TPHP. Docking results suggested that the three aryl groups played an essential role in the binding of these chemicals to LXRalpha. They also activated LXRalpha-mediated lipogenesis pathway and promoted lipid accumulation in HepG2 cells. The intracellular concentration and LXRalpha-bound concentration of the chemicals in HepG2 cells followed a consistent order of CDP > TCRP > TPHP. In mice, exposure to CDP activated LXRalpha-mediated de novo lipogenesis pathway, leading to hepatic steatosis. Risk assessment results suggested that few populations (5.38 %) face a LXRalpha-mediated hepatic steatosis risk from CDP exposure. Collectively, our results demonstrate that CDP could bind to LXRalpha, activate the subsequent de novo lipogenesis pathway, inducing hepatic steatosis, and increasing adverse health risks.
abstract_zh: 磷酸甲苯二苯酯（CDP）作为一种新型有机磷酸酯（OPE），已在多种环境和人体样本中被日益检出。然而，其毒性、机制及健康风险仍大多未知。在本研究中，我们通过肝X受体α（LXRalpha）通路，从分子相互作用、信号通路、细胞功能、动物效应及人群风险等方面，探讨了CDP诱导的肝脂肪变性，并与磷酸三苯酯（TPHP）和磷酸三甲苯酯（TCRP）进行了比较。受体结合结果显示，三种OPEs均能直接结合LXRalpha，其结合顺序为TCRP > CDP > TPHP。分子对接结果表明，三个芳基在这些化学物质与LXRalpha的结合中发挥了关键作用。它们还激活了LXRalpha介导的脂质生成通路，并促进了HepG2细胞中的脂质积累。在HepG2细胞中，这些化学物质的细胞内浓度及LXRalpha结合浓度遵循一致顺序：CDP > TCRP > TPHP。在小鼠中，暴露于CDP激活了LXRalpha介导的从头脂质生成通路，导致肝脂肪变性。风险评估结果表明，少数人群（5.38%）面临CDP暴露引起的LXRalpha介导的肝脂肪变性风险。总体而言，我们的结果表明，CDP能结合LXRalpha，激活随后的从头脂质生成通路，诱导肝脂肪变性，并增加不良健康风险。
